notes: Srisailam Dam’s 511 m gravity crossing, twelve closed radial gate assemblies, tapered spillway piers, steel maintenance walk, stilling apron, solid wings and the right-bank powerhouse. The crest and powerhouse plan follow the retained PMTiles map. The apron section, wing outlets, gate machinery and powerhouse elevation are exterior approximations based on the reference photos and standard terrain. Standard terrain contains spurious deep negative elevations near the crossing and provides stages of 252.82 m upstream and 179.68 m downstream. Native bank, base and water fit remain pending. The model depicts the dry closed-gate configuration. Left-bank generating chambers and internal conduits are underground and outside the exterior model.
